rules.description: Enforce strict typing across Python (strict mypy/type hints) and TypeScript (strict mode enabled, no implicit any).

Strictly forbid calling external or commercial LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, external cloud LLM inference). All intelligence, matching, and vector embeddings must be performed offline or using open-source local models (e.g., sentence-transformers) and deterministic rule engines.

Strictly forbid any integration, connection, or transaction submission to public mainnet blockchains or cryptocurrency networks. Any distributed ledger verification must use local testnets or mocked cryptographic ledgers.
